questions.prompt: When do you usually listen to music?
questions.sampleA2:
I listen to music when I am happy.

And I listen when I am sad.

Because music is good.
questions.sampleB1:
I usually listen to music when I'm travelling to work on the bus.

I think it helps me to relax and not worry about the traffic.

Also, I listen to music sometimes when I'm cooking dinner.

It makes cooking more fun.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I listen to music pretty much all the time. I usually put some music on first thing in the morning to wake myself up, and I always have my headphones in on the way to work. I suppose the main time is when I'm working out, though, because it really keeps me motivated and helps me push through a tough session.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men xursand bo'lganimda musiqa tinglayman.

Va men xafa bo'lganimda ham tinglayman.

Chunki musiqa yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men odatda ishga avtobusda ketayotganimda musiqa tinglayman.

O'ylashimcha, bu menga dam olishga va tirbandlik haqida qayg'urmaslikka yordam beradi.

Shuningdek, ba'zan kechki ovqat tayyorlayotganimda ham musiqa tinglayman.

Bu ovqat tayyorlashni yanada qiziqarli qiladi.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men odatda musiqa tinglashga ko'proq mashq qilayotganimda moyil bo'laman. Bu meni mashqlarim davomida o'zimni qattiqroq zo'riqtirishga chinakam ruhlantiradi.

Shuningdek, men uy ishlarini qilayotganimda, masalan, tozalash yoki kir yuvish kabi ishlarni qilayotganimda ham musiqa qo'yishni yoqtiraman. Bu vazifalar zerikarliroq tuyulishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi.

Bundan tashqari, agar men stressda yoki xavotirda bo'lsam, ko'pincha dam olish va stressdan xalos bo'lish usuli sifatida musiqaga murojaat qilaman. Bu men uchun juda samarali kurashish mexanizmi.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - When do you usually listen to music?...
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I find myself indulging in music during various moments throughout the day." - "Rostini aytsam, kun davomida turli paytlarda musiqani tinglashga berilaman."

"From my perspective, music serves as a constant companion, whether I'm commuting or unwinding." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, musiqani tinglash men uchun doimiy hamrohdur, xoh sayohat qilayotgan bo‘lsam, xoh dam olayotgan bo‘lsam."
"I'd have to say that my musical moments are intricately woven into my daily routine." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, musiqiy lahzalarim kundalik tartibimga chiroyli bog'langan."

questions.sampleAnswer: Honestly, I listen to music at various times throughout the day, as it plays a significant role in my daily routine. First and foremost, I kick off my day by listening to some soothing tunes during breakfast. It's a wonderful way to set a positive tone for the day ahead. Later, when I'm commuting to work, I plug in my headphones and tune into upbeat tracks that energize me and get me into the right mindset. Moreover, during work breaks, I often reach for my phone to catch up on the latest hits. It helps me relax and clear my head before diving back into work. In the evenings, I unwind with some jazz or classical music, which creates a calming ambiance and allows me to let my hair down after a long day. "Music is the universal language of mankind", and I genuinely believe it enhances every aspect of life. It brings out a range of emotions and can turn around a bad day in an instant. Ultimately, music is an integral part of my life, and I can't imagine a day without it.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Rostini aytsam, men kun davomida turli vaqtlarda musiqa tinglayman, chunki u kundalik hayotimda muhim rol o'ynaydi. Avvalo, nonushta paytida bir nechta yoqimli musiqalarni tinglash bilan kunimni boshlayman. Bu oldinda turgan kun uchun ijobiy kayfiyat yaratishning ajoyib usuli. Keyinroq, ishga qatnayotganimda, quloqchinlarimni taqib, meni tetiklashtiradigan va to'g'ri kayfiyatga soladigan jo'shqin treklarni tinglayman.

Bundan tashqari, ish tanaffuslarida men ko'pincha eng so'nggi xitlarni tinglash uchun telefonimga murojaat qilaman. Bu menga dam olishga va ishga qaytishdan oldin fikrlarimni tozalashga yordam beradi. Kechqurunlari men jaz yoki klassik musiqa bilan hordiq chiqaraman, bu tinchlantiruvchi muhit yaratadi va uzoq kundan keyin dam olishimga imkon beradi.

"Musiqa - insoniyatning universal tilidir", va men chin dildan uning hayotning har bir jabhasini yaxshilashiga ishonaman. U turli xil his-tuyg'ularni uyg'otadi va bir zumda yomon kunni yaxshi tomonga o'zgartirishi mumkin. Umuman olganda, musiqa mening hayotimning ajralmas qismi va men usiz bir kunni tasavvur qila olmayman.

questions.prompt: What do you do to stay healthy?
questions.sampleA2: I eat fruit and vegetables. I like to walk in the park. I sleep eight hours and I feel good.
questions.sampleB1: I try to stay healthy by eating well. I think it's important to eat fruits and vegetables. I also exercise, for example, I go running twice a week. However, sometimes it's difficult because I am busy with work.
questions.sampleB2: Well, the thing is, I try to keep on top of both my diet and my fitness. I cut down on junk food and make sure I eat plenty of fruit and veg. On top of that, I go for a run three times a week, and I try to get an early night whenever I can, because a decent sleep makes all the difference.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men meva va sabzavotlar yeyman. Men parkda sayr qilishni yaxshi ko'raman. Men sakkiz soat uxlayman va o'zimni yaxshi his qilaman.
questions.uzSampleB1: Men yaxshi ovqatlanish orqali sog'lom bo'lishga harakat qilaman. Menimcha, meva va sabzavotlarni iste'mol qilish muhim. Men ham jismoniy mashqlar qilaman, masalan, haftada ikki marta yuguraman. Biroq, ba'zan bu qiyin, chunki men ish bilan bandman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Sog'lom bo'lish uchun men o'zimning ham jismoniy, ham ruhiy farovonligimga e'tibor qarataman. Men meva, sabzavot va kam yog'li oqsillarga boy bo'lgan muvozanatli ovqatlanishga harakat qilaman. Shuningdek, muntazam ravishda sport bilan shug'ullanishga harakat qilaman, xoh yugurish, xoh suzish yoki yoga bilan shug'ullanish bo'lsin.

Bundan tashqari, men stress darajasini boshqarish juda muhim deb hisoblayman. Men buni onglilik va meditatsiya bilan shug'ullanish, shuningdek, o'zimga yoqqan mashg'ulotlar uchun vaqt ajratish orqali amalga oshiraman. Bu har doim ham oson emas, lekin men bu narsalarga ustuvor ahamiyat berish mening umumiy sog'lig'imda katta farq qilishini angladim.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - What do you do to stay healthy?...
idioms: "An apple a day keeps the doctor away" - "Bir kunda bitta olma doktorni uzoq qiladi"
burn the midnight oil - "kechasi bilan mehnat qilish"
in the pink of health - "sog'lom va baquvvat"
"You are what you eat" - "Siz nima yeysangiz, shusiz"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I prioritize my well-being by engaging in regular physical activities and maintaining a balanced diet." - "Rostini aytsam, men muntazam jismoniy mashqlar bilan shug'ullanish va muvozanatli ovqatlanishni afzal ko'raman."

"From my perspective, leading a healthy lifestyle is paramount, which involves everything from adequate sleep to stress management." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, sog'lom turmush tarzini olib borish juda muhim bo'lib, u yetarli uyqudan tortib, stressni boshqarishgacha bo'lgan hamma narsani o'z ichiga oladi."

"I'd have to say that my approach to health is holistic, encompassing both physical fitness and mental well-being." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, mening sog'lig'imga yondashuvim holistik bo'lib, u jismoniy tayyorgarlik va ruhiy farovonlikni o'z ichiga oladi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
To maintain a healthy lifestyle, I have adopted a balanced approach that incorporates both physical activity and a nutritious diet. "An apple a day keeps the doctor away," and I truly believe in the power of wholesome nutrition. Every morning, I begin my day with a hearty breakfast, often including whole grains and fresh fruits, which kick-starts my metabolism.

In terms of exercise, I've made it a habit to work out at least five times a week. I engage in a variety of activities ranging from cardio to strength training, ensuring that I don't put all my eggs in one basket. This diverse regimen not only keeps me physically fit but also helps me unwind and let my hair down after a hectic day. For me, hitting the gym is not just about physical health; it's a mental escape as well.

Furthermore, I prioritize getting enough sleep and staying hydrated, which are key components of overall well-being. I always hit the sack around the same time each night to ensure consistency, which remarkably enhances my energy levels throughout the day.

In conclusion, by combining a nutritious diet, regular exercise, and sufficient rest, I am able to maintain my health and live a more fulfilling life. After all, "health is wealth," and it's something I'm incredibly committed to preserving.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Sog'lom turmush tarzini saqlash uchun men jismoniy faollik va to'yimli ovqatlanishni o'z ichiga olgan muvozanatli yondashuvni qabul qildim. "Har kuni bir dona olma yesang, doktorga hojat qolmaydi", degan maqolga men chin dildan ishonaman va foydali oziqlanishning kuchiga ishonaman. Har kuni ertalab men kunimni to'yimli nonushta bilan boshlayman, ko'pincha tarkibida to'liq donlar va yangi mevalar bo'ladi, bu esa metabolizmni tezlashtiradi.

Jismoniy mashqlar nuqtai nazaridan, men haftada kamida besh marta mashq qilishni odat qildim. Men kardio mashqlardan tortib kuch mashqlarigacha bo'lgan turli xil mashg'ulotlar bilan shug'ullanaman, bu esa barcha tuxumlarni bir savatga solmaslikni ta'minlaydi. Ushbu xilma-xil rejim meni nafaqat jismonan sog'lom qiladi, balki band kundan keyin dam olishga va hordiq chiqarishga yordam beradi. Men uchun sport zaliga borish faqat jismoniy sog'liq haqida emas; bu ruhiy qochish hamdir.

Bundan tashqari, men yetarli uxlashga va suv balansini saqlashga ustunlik beraman, bular umumiy farovonlikning asosiy tarkibiy qismlaridir. Men har doim har kecha bir vaqtda uxlashga harakat qilaman, bu esa kun davomida energiya darajasini sezilarli darajada oshiradi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, to'yimli ovqatlanish, muntazam jismoniy mashqlar va yetarli dam olishni birlashtirib, men sog'lig'imni saqlay olaman va yanada mazmunli hayot kechira olaman. Axir, "sog'lik - boylik", va men buni saqlashga juda sodiqman.

questions.sampleA1: I go to school. My school is big. I like my teacher. We learn.
questions.sampleA2: My school is good. It is big and has many students. I like my classes, especially English. We learn new things and play games. My teacher is nice and helps me a lot.
questions.sampleB1: My school is a pretty good place to learn. It's quite big and has a lot of students from different backgrounds. I think the teachers are mostly helpful, and they try to make the lessons interesting. For example, in English class, we often read stories and discuss them. However, sometimes it can be a bit noisy, which makes it hard to concentrate.
questions.sampleB2: My school is a fairly big state school on the edge of town. To be honest, it's nothing fancy, but it's got a friendly atmosphere. The teachers go out of their way to help you, and there are loads of after-school clubs to get involved in. I suppose what I like most is that everyone gets on pretty well, so it never feels too competitive.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men maktabga boraman. Mening maktabim katta. Menga o'qituvchim yoqadi. Biz o'rganamiz.
questions.uzSampleA2: Mening maktabim yaxshi. U katta va unda ko'p o'quvchilar bor. Menga darslarim yoqadi, ayniqsa ingliz tili. Biz yangi narsalarni o'rganamiz va o'yinlar o'ynaymiz. Mening o'qituvchim yaxshi va menga juda ko'p yordam beradi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Mening maktabim o'qish uchun juda yaxshi joy. U ancha katta va turli xil kelib chiqishga ega bo'lgan ko'plab o'quvchilar bor. O'ylashimcha, o'qituvchilar asosan yordam berishadi va ular darslarni qiziqarli qilishga harakat qilishadi. Misol uchun, ingliz tili darsida biz ko'pincha hikoyalar o'qiymiz va ularni muhokama qilamiz. Biroq, ba'zida biroz shovqin bo'lishi mumkin, bu esa diqqatni jamlashni qiyinlashtiradi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Mening maktabim shahar chekkasida joylashgan umumiy o'rta ta'lim maktabi. U nisbatan zamonaviy bino va mukammal bo'lmasa-da, munosib ta'lim muhitini ta'minlaydi. Men ayniqsa, bahs munozara klubiga e'tibor qaratilishini qadrlayman, bu menga tanqidiy fikrlash qobiliyatimni rivojlantirishga yordam berdi. Garchi resurslar yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, ayniqsa, fan bo'limida, o'qituvchilar odatda o'z fanlariga sodiq va ishtiyoqlidir. Umuman olganda, bu o'quvchilar o'z salohiyatiga erishishga undaydigan qo'llab-quvvatlovchi jamoadir.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - Tell me about your school....
idioms: pass with flying colors - "yuqori natijalar bilan o'tmoq"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I cherished my time at school because it laid the foundation for my future endeavors." - "Rostini aytsam, maktabda o'tkazgan vaqtimni qadrlayman, chunki u kelajakdagi harakatlarim uchun poydevor yaratdi."

"From my perspective, school was a microcosm of society, offering a plethora of learning opportunities." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, maktab jamiyatning kichik bir ko'rinishi edi, ko'plab o'rganish imkoniyatlarini taqdim etardi."

"I'd have to say that my school was instrumental in shaping my character and instilling core values." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, mening maktabim xarakterimni shakllantirishda va asosiy qadriyatlarni singdirishda muhim rol o'ynadi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
"Education is the passport to the future", and I strongly believe my school exemplified this notion perfectly. My secondary school was a place where I grew up not just academically, but also emotionally and socially. It was a rather prominent institution, nestled in the heart of the city, surrounded by lush greenery, which always provided a serene backdrop for learning.

The infrastructure was incredibly modern, with state-of-the-art science labs and a well-stocked library that I used to lose myself in for hours. In terms of educational philosophy, the school was unwaveringly committed to fostering critical thinking and creativity. Teachers were more like mentors who encouraged us to explore our potential rather than just focus on rote learning.

I must say, extracurricular activities played a pivotal role in shaping my personality. Whether it was participating in drama club or being a part of the basketball team, these activities helped me hone my skills and boost my confidence. All in all, I genuinely cherished my time there, and it laid a solid foundation for my future endeavors. Looking back, I can confidently say that my school was not just an institution, but a second home where I formed lasting friendships and learned invaluable lessons.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
"Ta'lim - kelajakka yo'llanma", va menimcha, mening maktabim bu tushunchani mukammal darajada namoyon etdi. Mening o'rta maktabim nafaqat akademik jihatdan, balki hissiy va ijtimoiy jihatdan ham o'sgan joyim edi. U shahar markazida joylashgan, serhasham ko'katlar bilan o'ralgan, doimo o'qish uchun sokin muhit yaratib beradigan mashhur muassasa edi.

Infratuzilma nihoyatda zamonaviy bo'lib, eng so'nggi fan laboratoriyalari va men soatlab o'zimni yo'qotib qo'yadigan yaxshi jihozlangan kutubxonasi bor edi. Ta'lim falsafasi nuqtai nazaridan, maktab tanqidiy fikrlash va ijodkorlikni rivojlantirishga qat'iy sodiq edi. O'qituvchilar shunchaki yodlashga e'tibor qaratish o'rniga, bizni o'z salohiyatimizni o'rganishga undaydigan murabbiylar edi.

Aytishim kerakki, darsdan tashqari mashg'ulotlar mening shaxsiyatimni shakllantirishda muhim rol o'ynadi. Teatr to'garagida qatnashish yoki basketbol jamoasining a'zosi bo'lishimdan qat'i nazar, bu mashg'ulotlar menga o'z mahoratimni oshirishga va ishonchimni mustahkamlashga yordam berdi. Umuman olganda, men u yerda o'tkazgan vaqtimni chin dildan qadrlayman va bu mening kelajakdagi harakatlarim uchun mustahkam poydevor yaratdi. O'tmishga nazar tashlasam, maktabim shunchaki muassasa emas, balki men uzoq muddatli do'stliklar orttirgan va bebaho saboqlar olgan ikkinchi uyim edi, deb ishonch bilan ayta olaman.

questions.prompt: What do you see in these pictures?
questions.sampleA1:
I see food.

I see people.

I see a shop.
questions.sampleA2:
I see pictures of food.

In one picture, there are many vegetables and a woman.

In the other picture, there is a family and a supermarket.

questions.sampleB1:
In the first picture, I see a market with lots of fruits and vegetables.

A woman is buying something there.

In the second picture, I see a family in a supermarket.

I think both pictures show people buying food, but in different places.
questions.sampleB2: In the first picture, we can clearly see a young woman at an outdoor market stall, looking at a vibrant display of fresh fruits and vegetables. She seems to be picking out some grapes, suggesting a focus on healthy eating. By contrast, the second image shows a family – a man, woman, and young girl – inside a modern supermarket. They're pushing a trolley full of groceries, with the child actively helping to put items in. While both scenes involve food shopping, the first highlights fresh, unpackaged produce, whereas the second depicts a more typical weekly shop for a family, likely including a mix of items. At the end of the day, they represent different approaches to buying food.

questions.sampleAnswer: In the first image, what strikes me immediately is the social experience of a bustling outdoor market. The young woman, with her curly hair and casual attire, seems to be picking up some fresh produce. Her smile genuinely reflects her happiness and engagement in the activity. The market stall is brimming with life, filled with colorful vegetables and fruits, which indicates the abundance of choice available. The vibrant atmosphere, enhanced by the bright orange tarps and the presence of other shoppers, brings the scene to life. This image really captures the essence of community interactions and the joy of selecting fresh produce. On the other hand, the second image presents a cheerful indoor setting at a grocery store, where a family is enjoying a shopping trip together. The young girl, seemingly excited, is putting items into a cart full of packaged goods. Her interaction with what appears to be her parents—both delightedly engaged in the activity—creates a warm, familial atmosphere. Their shared laughter speaks volumes about the bond they share. The shelves, lined with products, highlight the convenience and multitude of options available in a modern supermarket. This scene paints a picture of a fun family outing, reinforcing the joy of everyday activities. Both images offer a glimpse into different aspects of shopping, one emphasizing community and the other family, yet both illustrate the simple pleasures in life. "It's not what we have in life, but who we have in our life that matters," and these images beautifully demonstrate this sentiment.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi suratda, darhol e'tiborni tortadigan narsa - gavjum ochiq havoda joylashgan bozordagi ijtimoiy tajriba. Jingalak sochli va oddiy kiyingan yosh ayol yangi mahsulotlarni tanlayotganga o'xshaydi. Uning tabassumi uning baxtini va bu jarayonga qiziqishini chin dildan aks ettiradi. Bozor rastasi rang-barang sabzavot va mevalarga to'la, hayot bilan jo'shqin, bu esa mavjud tanlovning ko'pligidan dalolat beradi. Yorqin to'q sariq brezentlar va boshqa xaridorlarning ishtiroki bilan kuchaytirilgan jonli muhit, sahnani jonlantiradi. Bu surat haqiqatan ham jamiyatning o'zaro munosabatlari va yangi mahsulotlarni tanlashdan zavqlanish mohiyatini aks ettiradi.

Boshqa tomondan, ikkinchi suratda supermarketda xursandchilik bilan xarid qilayotgan oilaning quvnoq ichki muhiti tasvirlangan. Xursand bo'lib ko'ringan yosh qiz, qadoqlangan mahsulotlarga to'la aravachaga narsalarni solmoqda. Uning ota-onasi bo'lib ko'ringan odamlar bilan bo'lgan munosabati - ikkalasi ham bu jarayonga xursandchilik bilan jalb qilingan - iliq, oilaviy muhitni yaratadi. Ularning birgalikdagi kulgusi ular o'rtasidagi rishtalar haqida ko'p narsani anglatadi. Mahsulotlar bilan to'ldirilgan javonlar zamonaviy supermarketda mavjud bo'lgan qulaylik va ko'plab imkoniyatlarni ta'kidlaydi. Bu sahna qiziqarli oilaviy sayrning tasvirini yaratadi va kundalik faoliyatdan zavqlanishni kuchaytiradi.

Ikkala surat ham xarid qilishning turli jihatlariga nazar tashlaydi, biri jamiyatni, ikkinchisi oilani ta'kidlaydi, ammo ikkalasi ham hayotdagi oddiy zavqlarni ko'rsatadi. "Hayotda nimaga ega ekanligimiz emas, balki hayotimizda kim borligi muhim", va bu suratlar bu tuyg'uni go'zal tarzda namoyish etadi.

questions.prompt: What is the advantage of buying products from local farmers over the supermarket?
questions.sampleA2: I like local farmers. They have good food. And it is fresh. But supermarket is easy.
questions.sampleB1: I think buying from local farmers is good. The food is fresher, for example, the tomatoes taste better. Also, it helps the farmers in my town. However, it can be more expensive than the supermarket.
questions.sampleB2: To my mind, the biggest advantage is freshness — the produce is usually picked that same morning, so it tastes miles better. On top of that, you're supporting local businesses and cutting out the middleman, which means the farmers get a fair price. It's a bit pricier, I suppose, but honestly the quality more than makes up for it.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga mahalliy fermerlar yoqadi. Ularda yaxshi ovqat bor. Va u yangi. Lekin supermarket oson.
questions.uzSampleB1: Menimcha, mahalliy fermerlardan xarid qilish yaxshi. Masalan, oziq-ovqat yangiroq, pomidorlar mazaliroq bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, bu mening shahrimdagi fermerlarga yordam beradi. Biroq, bu supermarketga qaraganda qimmatroq bo'lishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Mahalliy fermerlardan mahsulot sotib olishning bir nechta afzalliklari bor.
Birinchidan, mahsulot odatda ancha yangi va mazaliroq bo'ladi, chunki u uzoq masofalarga sayohat qilmagan. Shuningdek, siz mahalliy iqtisodiyotni qo'llab-quvvatlaysiz va kichik biznesning rivojlanishiga yordam berasiz. Bu supermarketga borishdan biroz noqulayroq bo'lishi mumkin, ammo foydalari bunga arziydi. Qolaversa, ko'pincha o'zingizning ovqatingizni yetishtiradigan odamlar bilan uchrashish imkoniga ega bo'lasiz, bu esa yoqimli tajriba.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - What is the advantage of buying products from loca...
idioms: "Put money where your mouth is" - "Gapni ish bilan isbotlash"
"Support your local farmer, feed your soul" - "Mahalliy fermeringizni qo'llab-quvvatlang, ruhingizni oziqlantiring"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I believe supporting local farmers is a wise choice due to..." - "Rostini aytsam, men mahalliy fermerlarni qo'llab-quvvatlashni oqilona tanlov deb bilaman, chunki..."
"From my perspective, purchasing from local farmers offers..." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, mahalliy fermerlardan xarid qilish..."
"I'd have to say that the benefits of buying local extend to..." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, mahalliy mahsulotlarni sotib olishning foydalari..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Purchasing products from local farmers boasts a multitude of benefits over opting for supermarket goods. Firstly, the freshness of produce from local markets is undeniably superior. When you buy straight from the horse's mouth, you're assured that the fruits and vegetables haven't been sitting in storage for weeks. Moreover, supporting local farmers goes beyond just getting fresh produce; it fosters community spirit and strengthens the local economy. It's a win-win situation where consumers enjoy high-quality produce, and farmers receive fair compensation for their hard work.

Another significant advantage is the environmental impact. Local farming practices are often more sustainable, with reduced transportation emissions compared to mass-produced supermarket goods. Furthermore, by choosing local, we contribute to preserving agricultural landscapes and biodiversity. "Think globally, act locally" couldn't be more relevant here.

Personally, I find it incredibly rewarding to engage with the farmers themselves. Hearing about their cultivation methods and the stories behind the produce creates a rich social experience. This connection adds a new dimension to my food that supermarkets simply can't replicate. In conclusion, the advantages of buying from local farmers are evident and multifaceted, ranging from quality and sustainability to community and economy.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Mahalliy fermerlardan mahsulot sotib olish supermarket mahsulotlarini tanlashga nisbatan ko'plab afzalliklarga ega. Birinchidan, mahalliy bozorlardan olingan mahsulotlarning yangiligi shubhasiz ustundir. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri manbadan xarid qilganingizda, meva va sabzavotlar haftalar davomida omborda saqlanmaganligiga ishonch hosil qilasiz. Bundan tashqari, mahalliy fermerlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash faqat yangi mahsulot olishdan tashqari, jamiyat ruhini rivojlantiradi va mahalliy iqtisodiyotni mustahkamlaydi. Bu iste'molchilar yuqori sifatli mahsulotlardan bahramand bo'ladigan va fermerlar o'zlarining mashaqqatli mehnati uchun adolatli tovon oladigan g'alaba-g'alaba vaziyatidir.

Yana bir muhim afzalligi - atrof-muhitga ta'siri. Mahalliy dehqonchilik usullari ko'pincha barqarorroq bo'ladi, ommaviy ishlab chiqarilgan supermarket mahsulotlariga nisbatan transport emissiyasi kamroq bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, mahalliy mahsulotni tanlash orqali biz qishloq xo'jaligi landshaftlari va biologik xilma-xillikni saqlashga hissa qo'shamiz. "Global fikrlang, mahalliy harakat qiling" degan maqol bu erda juda dolzarbdir.

Shaxsan men fermerlarning o'zlari bilan muloqot qilishni juda foydali deb bilaman. Ularning yetishtirish usullari va mahsulotlar ortidagi hikoyalar haqida eshitish boy ijtimoiy tajriba yaratadi. Bu aloqa mening ovqatlanishimga supermarketlar oddiygina takrorlay olmaydigan yangi o'lchov qo'shadi. Xulosa qilib aytganda, mahalliy fermerlardan xarid qilishning afzalliklari aniq va ko'p qirrali bo'lib, sifat va barqarorlikdan tortib jamiyat va iqtisodiyotgacha.

questions.prompt: Why do some people like to do shopping in the supermarket?
questions.sampleA1: I like supermarket. Food is there. Easy.
questions.sampleA2: I like supermarket because it's easy. They have many things and I can buy food and drinks. It is near my house and I go there with my mum.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think people like supermarkets because it's very convenient. You can find everything you need in one place, like food and cleaning supplies. Also, the prices are usually better than in small shops. For example, you can buy a big bottle of juice for less money. So, it's easier and cheaper to shop there.
questions.sampleB2: Well, for a lot of people it comes down to convenience. You can get everything under one roof, so you don't have to traipse around lots of shops. The prices tend to be fairly competitive too, and I suppose people like being able to stock up on a week's food in one go, with a huge range of brands to choose from.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga supermarket yoqadi. U yerda ovqat bor. Oson.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men supermarketni yaxshi ko'raman, chunki u oson. Ularda ko'p narsalar bor va men ovqat va ichimliklar sotib olishim mumkin. U mening uyimga yaqin va men u yerga onam bilan boraman.
questions.uzSampleB1: Xo'sh, menimcha odamlar supermarketlarni yaxshi ko'rishadi, chunki bu juda qulay. Sizga kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani bir joyda topishingiz mumkin, masalan, oziq-ovqat va tozalash vositalari. Bundan tashqari, narxlar odatda kichik do'konlarga qaraganda yaxshiroq bo'ladi. Masalan, siz katta bir shisha sharbatni arzonroq pulga sotib olishingiz mumkin. Shunday qilib, u yerda xarid qilish osonroq va arzonroq.
questions.uzSampleB2: Odamlar bir qator sabablarga ko'ra supermarketlarga intilishadi, asosan qulaylik tufayli. Oziq-ovqat mahsulotlaridan tortib, uy-ro'zg'or buyumlarigacha bo'lgan keng turdagi mahsulotlarni bir joyda xarid qilish imkoniyati xarid jarayonini sezilarli darajada soddalashtiradi. Bundan tashqari, supermarketlar ko'pincha raqobatbardosh narxlarni taklif etadi, bu esa iste'molchilarga xarid qobiliyatini maksimal darajada oshirish imkonini beradi. Tovarlarning tartibli joylashuvi va qulayligi ham umuman olganda ijobiy xarid tajribasiga hissa qo'shadi. Shuni ham ta'kidlash joizki, mavjud bo'lgan xilma-xillik ham jozibador bo'lishi mumkin; sizda tanlash uchun keng turdagi brendlar va mahsulotlar mavjud.

"I'd have to say that the vast array of products available is a significant factor for many." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, ko‘plab mahsulotlarning keng tanlovi ko‘pchilik uchun muhim omildir."

questions.sampleAnswer:
There are several reasons why people enjoy shopping in supermarkets. Firstly, the sheer convenience of having everything under one roof is immensely appealing. Supermarkets cater to a vast array of needs, from groceries to household items, which saves a ton of time and effort.

Moreover, the prices in supermarkets are typically more competitive, allowing customers to get the best value for their money. This is particularly important in today's economy, where budget-conscious shoppers look for bargains. In addition, the organized layout and easy accessibility of products provide a pleasant shopping experience.

Another aspect is the social dimension; shopping in a supermarket can be a social experience where people run into acquaintances or catch up with friends. "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy," and shopping can be a way to let one's hair down.

Personally, I find the variety of products and brands available in supermarkets incredibly satisfying. Whether it's trying new foods or discovering high-quality goods, the experience is undeniably rewarding. So, in essence, supermarkets offer a reliable mix of convenience, value, and diversity, which is why they remain so popular among consumers.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Odamlarning supermarketlarda xarid qilishni yoqtirishlarining bir nechta sabablari bor. Birinchidan, hamma narsaning bir tom ostida bo'lishining qulayligi juda jozibali. Supermarketlar oziq-ovqat mahsulotlaridan tortib uy-ro'zg'or buyumlarigacha bo'lgan keng ko'lamli ehtiyojlarni qondiradi, bu esa juda ko'p vaqt va kuchni tejaydi.

Bundan tashqari, supermarketlardagi narxlar odatda raqobatbardoshroq bo'lib, xaridorlarga o'z pullariga eng yaxshi qiymatni olish imkonini beradi. Bu, ayniqsa, bugungi iqtisodiyotda muhim, bunda byudjetga e'tiborli xaridorlar arzon narxlarni qidiradi. Bundan tashqari, mahsulotlarning tartibli joylashuvi va oson kirish imkoniyati yoqimli xarid qilish tajribasini ta'minlaydi.

Yana bir jihati - ijtimoiy o'lcham; supermarketda xarid qilish ijtimoiy tajriba bo'lishi mumkin, bunda odamlar tanishlariga duch kelishadi yoki do'stlari bilan gaplashib olishadi. "Faqat ish va o'yin-kulgi yo'qligi odamni zerikarli qiladi" va xarid qilish dam olishning bir usuli bo'lishi mumkin.

Shaxsan men supermarketlarda mavjud bo'lgan mahsulotlar va brendlarning xilma-xilligi juda qoniqarli ekanligini his qilaman. Yangi ovqatlarni sinab ko'rish yoki yuqori sifatli mahsulotlarni kashf etishdan qat'i nazar, bu tajriba shubhasiz foydali. Shunday qilib, mohiyatan, supermarketlar qulaylik, qiymat va xilma-xillikning ishonchli aralashmasini taklif qiladi, shuning uchun ular iste'molchilar orasida juda mashhur bo'lib qolmoqda.

questions.sampleA1: I like food. My grandma cooks. It is good. I eat.
questions.sampleA2: I like my grandma's food. She makes good food. I like it because it is tasty. And my family eats together.
questions.sampleB1: My grandma is a good cook. I think her food is the best. For example, she makes a really nice cake. It's very special because we eat it together as a family. However, sometimes she makes too much food!
questions.sampleB2: Right, so the special meal I'd like to talk about is a birthday dinner my grandmother cooked for me a couple of years ago. To be honest, she's an absolutely brilliant cook, and she went all out for the occasion. She spent the whole day slaving away in the kitchen, preparing this huge spread of traditional dishes — there was osh, homemade bread, salads, the lot. As for who cooked it, like I said, it was my grandmother, though my mum pitched in and gave her a hand with the side dishes. The thing is, my gran doesn't often get the chance to cook for everyone these days, so she really pulled out all the stops to make it memorable. She even baked my favourite cake from scratch, which must have taken hours. How did I feel about it? Well, honestly, I was deeply touched. It's one thing to be given a present, but when someone puts in that much time and effort, it really means the world to you. I suppose what made it so special wasn't just the food itself, delicious as it was, but the fact that the whole family sat down together and had a proper catch-up. We were chatting away and laughing for hours. Looking back, it's a memory I'll always treasure. At the end of the day, food has a funny way of bringing people together, and that evening summed that up perfectly. It's the sort of evening you'd give anything to relive. I still bring it up whenever we're all round the table.

bulletPoints: Describe a special meal that someone prepared for you.
questions.sampleAnswer:
One of the most memorable culinary experiences I've ever had was when my grandmother prepared a traditional feast for my birthday. She is an exceptional cook, renowned in our family for her ability to whip up the most delectable dishes. The meal was not just about the food itself, but rather a social experience that brought our family together.

She went out of her way to recreate an old family recipe, a sumptuous lamb stew which has been passed down through generations. The rich aroma of the stew, combined with the warmth of freshly baked bread, filled the entire house, making it feel like home. Every bite was a testament to her love and dedication.

I genuinely felt a profound sense of gratitude and appreciation. It was as if each ingredient was meticulously chosen to tell a story, almost like she was imparting a piece of our family's heritage to me. The meal was incredibly heartwarming, and I felt an overwhelming sense of belonging, reminding me that "there's no place like home" when you're surrounded by loved ones.

Mening eng yodda qolarli taom tajribalarimdan biri, bu buvim mening tug'ilgan kunim uchun an'anaviy ziyofat tayyorlagan payt edi. U juda mohir oshpaz, oilamizda eng mazali taomlarni tayyorlash qobiliyati bilan mashhur.

U avloddan-avlodga o'tib kelayotgan eski oilaviy retseptni, ajoyib qo'zichoq dimlamasini qayta yaratish uchun bor kuchini sarfladi. Dimlamaning boy hidi, yangi pishirilgan nonning iliqligi bilan birga, butun uyni to'ldirib, uni haqiqiy uydek his qildirdi. Har bir luqma uning sevgisi va sadoqatining dalili edi.

Men chin dildan chuqur minnatdorchilik va qadrlash hissini tuyg'u qildim. Go'yo har bir masalliq hikoya qilish uchun sinchkovlik bilan tanlangan, xuddi u oilamizning merosidan bir bo'lagini menga o'rgatayotgandek edi. Taom juda dilga yaqin edi va men o'zimni juda tegishli his qildim, bu menga yaqinlaringiz bilan o'ralashganingizda "uydek joy yo'q" ekanligini eslatdi.

questions.prompt: Students should wear uniforms at school.
questions.sampleA2:
I think uniform is okay.

It is easy because I don't need to choose clothes.

But maybe it's boring.
questions.sampleB1:
I think uniforms are a good idea for schools.

For example, everyone looks the same and it's fair.

Also, it's easier in the morning because you don't have to decide what to wear.

However, some students might not like them because they want to choose their own clothes.
questions.sampleB2: Right, so the statement is that students should wear uniforms at school, and to be honest, I can see both sides of the argument. On the one hand, there's a strong case for uniforms. For a start, they promote a sense of equality, because everyone's dressed the same and nobody stands out for wearing expensive designer clothes. This means students are far less likely to get caught up in comparing themselves to one another, which can honestly take a toll on a teenager's confidence. On top of that, wearing the same kit creates a real sense of unity and belonging — it makes pupils feel like they're all in it together. On the other hand, there are some valid arguments against them. The thing is, school uniforms can be pretty pricey, which puts a strain on families who are already struggling to make ends meet. They're not always the most comfortable thing to wear either. And I suppose the biggest drawback is that they can hold students back from expressing their own personality through what they wear. For instance, a lot of teenagers see fashion as a big part of who they are, so being forced into the same blazer and tie every day can feel quite stifling. At the end of the day, though, if you ask me, the benefits just about win out. I do think there's real value in levelling the playing field, so long as schools keep the cost down. So all in all, I'd come down in favour of uniforms, but only within reason.

Shuningdek, har kuni bir xil kiyim kiyish o'quvchining o'ziga xosligini va shaxsiy uslubini ifoda etish qobiliyatini cheklaydi, bu esa, menimcha, muhim, ayniqsa o'smirlik davrida.

vocabulary.title: Q8 - Students should wear uniforms at school....
idioms: "Cut from the same cloth" - "Bir xil matodan kesilgan"

for: School uniforms promote a sense of equality among students.
Students are less likely to be preoccupied with their appearance or compare themselves to others
Uniforms create a strong sense of unity

The same clothes limit pupils' ability to express themselves through their clothing choices

questions.sampleAnswer:
In my opinion, the question of whether students should wear uniforms at school is undoubtedly multifaceted. On the one hand, uniforms promote a sense of equality among students, which can be incredibly beneficial in fostering an inclusive environment. When everyone is dressed similarly, students are less likely to compare themselves to their peers based on their attire. This can minimize distractions related to fashion trends and allow them to focus more on their studies.

Moreover, uniforms can instill a sense of unity and pride within the school community. They become a symbol of collective identity, and students often find themselves part of something larger than themselves. This shared identity can bring about a sense of belonging, which is essential for young people.

However, on the flip side, school uniforms can be quite expensive for families, especially those with multiple children. The cost of uniforms might burden some households, putting a strain on their finances. Additionally, uniforms may not always be designed with comfort in mind, and students could find them restrictive or uncomfortable throughout the long school day.

Furthermore, uniforms limit students' ability to express themselves through their clothing choices. Adolescence is a time for exploring one's identity, and fashion is often a key avenue for self-expression. By wearing uniforms, students miss out on the opportunity to communicate their personalities and preferences, which can be crucial for their personal growth.

In conclusion, while school uniforms certainly have their advantages in terms of promoting equality and unity, the drawbacks such as cost and limited self-expression should not be overlooked. As the saying goes, "Variety is the spice of life," and allowing students the freedom to choose their attire could ultimately contribute to a more dynamic and enriched school experience. Personally, I believe a balanced approach, where uniforms are optional, might best serve the diverse needs of students.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Menimcha, o'quvchilar maktabda forma kiyishi kerakmi yoki yo'qmi degan savol, shubhasiz, ko'p qirrali. Bir tomondan, forma o'quvchilar o'rtasida tenglik tuyg'usini rivojlantiradi, bu esa inklyuziv muhitni yaratishda juda foydali bo'lishi mumkin. Hamma bir xil kiyinganida, o'quvchilar o'zlarini kiyimlari asosida tengdoshlari bilan solishtirish ehtimoli kamroq bo'ladi. Bu moda tendentsiyalari bilan bog'liq chalg'ituvchi omillarni kamaytirishi va ularga o'qishga ko'proq e'tibor qaratishga imkon beradi.

Bundan tashqari, forma maktab jamoasida birlik va faxr tuyg'usini singdirishi mumkin. Ular jamoaviy o'zlik ramziga aylanadi va o'quvchilar ko'pincha o'zlarini o'zlaridan kattaroq narsaning bir qismi deb bilishadi. Bu umumiy o'zlik yoshlar uchun zarur bo'lgan mansublik tuyg'usini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

Biroq, boshqa tomondan, maktab formalari oilalar uchun, ayniqsa, bir nechta farzandi bo'lganlar uchun juda qimmatga tushishi mumkin. Formalarning narxi ba'zi oilalarga og'irlik qilishi, ularning moliyaviy ahvoliga ta'sir qilishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, formalar har doim ham qulaylikni hisobga olgan holda ishlab chiqilmasligi mumkin va o'quvchilar ularni uzoq o'quv kuni davomida cheklovchi yoki noqulay deb topishlari mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, forma o'quvchilarning kiyim tanlash orqali o'zini ifoda etish qobiliyatini cheklaydi. O'smirlik - bu o'z shaxsini o'rganish davri va moda ko'pincha o'zini ifoda etishning asosiy usuli hisoblanadi. Forma kiyish orqali o'quvchilar o'zlarining shaxsiyati va afzalliklarini etkazish imkoniyatini qo'ldan boy beradilar, bu ularning shaxsiy o'sishi uchun juda muhim bo'lishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, maktab formalari tenglik va birlikni targ'ib qilish nuqtai nazaridan afzalliklarga ega bo'lsa-da, xarajat va o'zini ifoda etishning cheklanganligi kabi kamchiliklarni e'tibordan chetda qoldirmaslik kerak. Aytganlaridek, "Rang-baranglik hayotga fayz beradi" va o'quvchilarga kiyim tanlash erkinligini berish oxir-oqibatda yanada dinamik va boy maktab tajribasiga hissa qo'shishi mumkin. Shaxsan men, formalarning ixtiyoriy bo'lishi kabi muvozanatli yondashuv o'quvchilarning turli ehtiyojlariga eng yaxshi xizmat qiladi deb hisoblayman.

\"Variety is the spice of life,\".uz: "Har narsaning yangisi yaxshi, do'stning esa qadimi"

\"All work and no play makes Jack a dull.uz: Dam olmagan bemor bo'lar, o'qimagan eshar bo'lar
